function_scope: OS/compositor window observations only; no panel cadence, photons, or exact same-submission correspondence

portable.OS_replacement_video: unavailable: bounded qualifier closed its window before recorder finalization; do not claim a replacement video

apple-tile.OS_replacement_video: unavailable: bounded qualifier closed its window before recorder finalization; do not claim a replacement video

computer_use: 2026-11-11 visible Codex session: cua.getApp(com.colliderli.iina) and cua.getApp(ThrumM2.app) succeeded; game access preflight opened a window briefly before GPU lock, immediately closed; no observation claimed from that preflight.
selected_video: Each window-response-1x.mp4 is the first eight seconds of the retained 65-second host-time OS recording, reencoded at original timestamps with libx264 CRF18; full source remains in tmp/g3t-m2/attended.
visual_review: Sun/night/noon settled OS frames compared to matching paused T2 references under both recipes. Sun disk, sky/stars, terrain, local lights and mirror present. These are matched states, not the same submission; no OS byte equality claimed.

portable.clock_limit: Recorder launch is host time, not calibrated movie frame correspondence; video starts after asynchronous recorder initialization. No exact submission/compositor correlation.

apple-tile.clock_limit: Recorder launch is host time, not calibrated movie frame correspondence; video starts after asynchronous recorder initialization. No exact submission/compositor correlation.

supplemental_video_failures: First visible-session portable attempt started before the window settled, recorder exit 1 and no movie; excluded. Delaying recorder start one second and limiting it to four seconds succeeded for both recipes.
recovery_video_encoding: Four-second original-time OS movies reencoded with libx264 CRF18, yuv420p; original .mov files retained in tmp/g3t-m2/attended/visible/<recipe>-recovery-settled-video.
reference_identity: Per-recipe <state>-t2-manifest.json.gz and <state>-t2-runtime.json.gz, plus t2-reference-records.json.gz. World paused, sunset yaw -90/solar 17.4; night yaw 0/pitch 7/solar 0; noon yaw/pitch 0/solar 12; source scene extent 1920x1080.
